Android\'s accessibility access lets the app see which app is on the screen, so it can close an app when its time is used up and stop the protection being turned off without your PIN. It reads the words on screen only in Settings and the app installer, to find this app\'s own pages. It does not read messages, passwords or what is typed, and nothing leaves this device.
